title: resource load fails if changed dir
body:
### Tested versions

reproducible in 4.5Beta-3

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta3 - Manjaro Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon, 03 Feb 2025 16:27:19 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) HD Graphics 4600 (HSW GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-4700HQ CPU @ 2.40GHz (8 threads) - 15.49 GiB memory

### Issue description

resource load fails if I save resource change the dir of script and try to load it.
since there's id of resource saved on the file:
if fail due to not in correct dir.
it should search for id.
and re-save the resource with correct dir.

this is saved on disc
```
[gd_resource type="Resource" script_class="SavingResource" load_steps=2 format=3]

[ext_resource type="Script" path="res://change folders/folder 2/saving_script.gd" id="1_esa3t"]

[resource]
script = ExtResource("1_esa3t")
some_var = 4
```
if I change
`[ext_resource type="Script" path="res://change folders/folder 2/saving_script.gd" id="1_esa3t"]`
to
`[ext_resource type="Script" path="res://change folders/folder 1/saving_script.gd" id="1_esa3t"]`

it works

### Steps to reproduce

1. force save resource
2. save resource
3. change resource directory (not save spot)(id remains same)
4. load resource
4. fail to load it
